description: Ambiguous social anxiety presentation — participant has some social fear but denies impairment and duration criteria. Tests specificity: system should return NO for social anxiety when key criteria are not met.
notes: Participant reports social nervousness but it does not rise to clinical disorder level — no functional impairment and less than 6 months duration.

responses.DEP_A1a: No, I'm generally in a good mood.
responses.SOC_F1a: Yes, I do get nervous before presentations at work.
responses.SOC_F2: I worry a bit about what people think, yes.
responses.SOC_F3: I don't really avoid them — I still go and just feel nervous.
responses.SOC_F4: No, it hasn't really affected my work or social life. I still do everything I need to.
